title: Critical label earns a bar; patterns re-graded to a selective pool
action: Per U6: author the bee.critical bar as a concept in the okf-profile area (critical = recurrence-prone + cross-feature + costly-when-missed; a pattern failing any leg is not critical). Then re-grade all 101 patterns' frontmatter against it — target at most ~30 critical — recording the per-pattern verdict reason in the commit body (grouped one-liners acceptable), never a bulk strip. Regenerate indexes (`bee knowledge index`), run `bee knowledge check` clean, and update any fixture/test asserting the old critical count. Reserve additional pattern files as you touch them.

truths: Critical pool is at most ~30 with a written bar
Every de-flagged pattern has a stated reason in the commit

artifacts.substantive: the bar as an OKF-valid concept

key_links: index.md Critical patterns section regenerated to the new pool

trace.outcome: Authored the bee.critical bar as an okf-profile concept and re-graded all 101 patterns to a 30-pattern critical pool; index regenerated clean
